'''Viv''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] assigned to the [[Rendezvous Point 4]] base on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. He supervised the modifications to the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Vindicator (light freighter)|''Vindicator'']] into a [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] for use against the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Havoc (Imperial-class)|''Havoc'']].
